factcheck.claim: May 4-29, 2026 contains a six-girl-group comeback pile-up involving BABYMONSTER, NMIXX, ITZY, I.O.I, LE SSERAFIM, and aespa.
NMIXX released Heavy Serenade on May 11, 2026.
ITZY's 12th EP Motto drops on May 18, 2026, with five member solo tracks and a U.S. physical release scheduled for May 22.
I.O.I returned with I.O.I : LOOP after being formed in 2016 and disbanding in 2017.
LE SSERAFIM's Celebration pre-release landed on April 24, 2026, ahead of the May 22 album.
aespa's Lemonade, a 10-track second full album, is scheduled for May 29, 2026.
K-pop album exports crossed $100 million for the first time in Q1 2026, with the U.S. overtaking Japan as the top destination.
